about: Owner, 2 Oct 2026: words of one root count as known together ONLY when they carry the same meaning. Each root's dictionary words (lemmas) split into same-meaning groups. Machine-proposed from the English meanings, then every root reviewed by hand against Qur'anic usage (precision first: when unsure, kept apart). Edit this file to correct a group; run build_meaning_groups.py to rebuild the app file.
